package.name: crowd_nav_pedestrians
package.description: Phase 4 pedestrian simulation: a single deterministic, seeded, sim-time-stepped social-force node (reactive/non_reactive as a config flag, ground-truth robot pose injected from Gazebo, not odom) publishing a ground-truth PedestrianArray topic, plus an optional launch-toggleable visual-only Gazebo actor mirror node. HuNav is not used (determinism is the requirement Phase 10's evaluation matrix needs, and a HuNav-wrapped social-force engine doesn't cleanly offer byte-identical seeded reproduction).
